“You are a human can opener.”

**Tank Killer** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Your ranged weapons ignore an increasing % of armor.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your ranged weapons ignore 40% armor. | 001D61E3 | 
| ★ | 1 | Your ranged weapons ignore 20% armor. | 0031D4BC | 

- Due to armor penetration being multiplicative, stacking Tank Killer with Anti-Armor or certain weapon mods will result in diminishing returns.
- As of patch 1.4.0.20, the Adventure mode variant of the perk applies to pistols as well as rifles.
- Although the perk card art for Tank Killer depicts a R91 assault rifle, this weapon is not available in the game.

 As of patch 1.4.0.20, the Adventure mode variant of Tank Killer 3 will not provide the 9% stagger chance for semi-automatic pistols, as it is missing the WeaponTypePistol keyword required to apply the stagger to that weapon type. The keyword is present for the 3% stagger rate for automatic pistols and will work as expected for automatic pistols as such. [verified]
